purpose: Demonstrate one product feature and connect it to one user benefit.
whenToUse: A feature has a named benefit and evidence asset
The feature can be understood in a short focused beat
whenNotToUse: More than one feature must compete in the same scene
The benefit is not supported by product evidence

layoutContract.focus: Crop or mask the evidence so the relevant control or result is prominent.
layoutContract.density: One feature and one benefit per scene.

motionContract.entrance: Introduce the evidence, move focus to the feature, then reveal the benefit.
motionContract.determinism: All highlights and camera moves use fixed coordinates and finite durations.
motionContract.media: Apply a subtle crop, pan, zoom, mask, or focus cue; do not leave a screenshot static for the whole scene.

transitionOptions.use: Carry the highlighted control into the next feature.

captionRules.copy: Prefer benefit language over interface labels already visible in the asset.
captionRules.placement: Do not cover the highlighted UI region.

fallbacks.action: Use a brand card only when the benefit is independently verified; otherwise omit the feature.
Use a bounded crop at native quality and pair it with a brand card instead of enlarging beyond 2x.

qaRules: Feature name and benefit map to the same input item
Referenced evidence asset exists and has an allowed license
Focal UI remains readable at delivery resolution
